reason: Room. The candidate adds 17 bytes to render.6502 in bank 4, and only the shipping build was checked for space (797 bytes, an old figure; really &B37D to REN_BASE &B400 = 131 bytes). The gameplay disc builds from this same render.6502 with GAMEPLAY_SHIELD and SKY_MODE, which add shield_hi.6502 and sky_edges.6502 after the sprites. In build/strykers-gameplay.lst (built 2026-10-23 01:23 from this tree), bank 4 ends at &B3F6 ('SKIP PAD_END' at line 11718, after sky_edges' RTS at &B3F5). That leaves 10 bytes, so +17 overruns REN_BASE by 7 and 'ASSERT * <= REN_BASE' in src/main.6502 line 151 fails: the gameplay disc no longer assembles. The full-flag gameplay listings, hud_rupture included, also end at &B3F6. The gate's BUILDS (bench, full, ship, release) never build -Gameplay, so it would not catch this. The logic itself checks out: the cycles recount to 36 down to 15 per skipped entry, which is 21 saved; take_off with need bit 7 clear is LDA/BPL/RTS; classify is the only writer of act, in ascending slot order. But the change does not fit its region in every build that shares the source.
